rules: Use separate component wrapper and address-space lanes; never global contiguous flash.
Stage layers overlap; bitmask preserves every gap without sampling.
Color priority exact C > compiled C > pseudocode > disassembly > unknown; mapped C alone is hatch/annotation, not compiled.
compiled C means selected mapped source compile; not integrated replacement or safe all-input behavior.
All complement/code-only classifications remain unknown, not binary-only.
Pseudocode is authenticated raw output; not full understood-function coverage.
Module labels are inferred source/ownership groups; storage partitions are not C module boundaries.
No newer aggregate symbol count is mapped spatially.
Lead dashboard with wholeRepositoryWork and buildProgress cards before address map.
Never present baseline verified joins as exhaustive repo work.
bit8 must be visually distinguished from verified C: candidate address binding, not behavior/equality.
Overlay resource types with labels; do not infer font/image/text-file/padding from strings or gaps.
Fonts/calibration evidence without exact asset bounds stays prominently unplaced.
Do not derive whole executable denominator by subtracting partial resource coverage.
